mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (isbn, title, author, publisher, category_id, cover, description, tags, total_stock, available_stock, publish_date) VALUES (#{isbn}, #{title}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{categoryId}, #{cover}, #{description}, #{tags}, #{totalStock}, #{totalStock}, #{publishDate})
mapper.sql: SELECT b.id, b.isbn, b.title, b.author, b.publisher, b.category_id, c.name AS category_name, b.cover, b.description, b.tags, b.total_stock, b.available_stock, b.publish_date, b.create_time FROM book b LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = b.category_id

mapper.update: UPDATE book SET available_stock = available_stock - 1 WHERE id = #{bookId} AND available_stock > 0
UPDATE book SET available_stock = available_stock + 1 WHERE id = #{bookId} AND available_stock < total_stock
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.isbn, b.title, b.author, b.publisher, b.category_id, c.name AS category_name, b.cover, b.description, b.tags, b.total_stock, b.available_stock, b.publish_date, b.create_time FROM book b LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN borrow_record r ON r.book_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.isbn, b.title, b.author, b.publisher, b.category_id, c.name, b.cover, b.description, b.tags, b.total_stock, b.available_stock, b.publish_date, b.create_time ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
